title: Rosemary Beach: Coquina Cottage in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Coquina Cottage in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

If you're looking for a spacious, four-bedroom home located right off the boardwalk on the Southside of 30A, look no further! You are a mere two minute's walk from the Gulf of Mexico along the boardwalk, and directly across from the largest pool in Rosemary, the Coquina Pool. Relaxing at the beach could not get easier!

The first floor boasts two guest bedrooms, each with their own en suite bathroom, and private balconies. The first bedroom contains a King-size bed, small desk, flat screen TV and a full bathroom, while the second bedroom is fit for the kids, with two twins and a trundle bed, as well as their own bathroom.

Ascend to the second floor to find the kitchen, dining, and living areas that are seamlessly connected by an incredible amount of natural light. Continue the fun after a long day at the beach in a full kitchen with stainless steel appliances and barstool seating that makes cooking meals with the family more than memorable. The hardwood floors and plush furniture truly epitomize coastal living, while making you feel right at home. Surrounding you are balconies galore, perfect for enjoying your morning coffee with the family or afternoon cocktails with friends!

The master bedroom encompasses the entire third floor, with a King bed, an office area, lounge area and a very large bath with a private dressing area. With plenty of closet space, the hardest part of checking into Coquina Cottage is not wanting to move in!

Just across the private courtyard is the cozy carriage house; with the open floor plan and expansive balcony that surrounds almost the entire carriage house, this one bedroom is the perfect peaceful retreat for a couple, or small family with a Queen size bed and pull-out couch. Enjoy lounging on the balcony, or in the adirondack chairs in the courtyard, where memories are sure to be made.

With access to four community pools, the Rosemary Beach Fitness Center, Racquet Club, and complimentary bikes at the property, Rosemary Beach will leave you speechless, and wanting to return year, after year! Why not start setting things in motion so you can have a beautiful and memorable Florida vacation with the ones you love?! You too could soon be relaxing on our pristine beach when you contact Rosemary Beach at (866) 348-8952 or book your stay in Coquina Cottage & Carriage House online today!

* In 2025, Property rents 7 nights, Saturday to Saturday, March 8th - August 8th*

Featured Amenities:
Wine fridge
